# labitcode — Engineering & Innovation Laboratory

> labitcode is an engineering laboratory exploring software architecture, frontier AI systems, autonomous agents, and cybersecurity. Founded by Alfonso Garcia, an experienced software engineer and tech innovator.

- Website: https://labitcode.com
- Spanish Edition: https://labitcode.com/es
- Full LLM Context (All Summaries): https://labitcode.com/llms-full.txt
- Author: Alfonso Garcia (https://github.com/alfoncode, https://twitter.com/alfoncode, https://linkedin.com/in/alfonsojosegarcia)
- Sitemaps: https://labitcode.com/sitemap-index.xml | https://labitcode.com/image-sitemap.xml
- Feeds: https://labitcode.com/rss.xml (EN) | https://labitcode.com/es/rss.xml (ES)

## Core Thematic Pillars

### 1. Frontier AI & Autonomous Agents
- [The AI Velocity Paradox](https://labitcode.com/blog/the-ai-velocity-paradox) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/la-paradoja-de-la-velocidad-de-la-ia): Why Altman, Amodei, and Musk called for breathers as AI self-improvement accelerates.
- [Claude Fable 5: Frontier Intelligence](https://labitcode.com/blog/claude-fable-5) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/claude-fable-5-es): 1M context window, adaptive thinking, and Anthropic's Mythos tier.
- [Kimi K3 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol & Claude Fable 5](https://labitcode.com/blog/kimi-k3-performance-pricing-comparison) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/comparativa-rendimiento-precio-kimi-k3): 2.8T parameter MoE architecture and cost-performance benchmark revolution.
- [GPT-5.6 Sol: The Next Frontier](https://labitcode.com/blog/gpt-5-6-sol) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/gpt-5-6-sol-es): Analysis of OpenAI's next-generation multimodal model.
- [Hermes: The Autonomous Agent Team](https://labitcode.com/blog/hermes-autonomous-team) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/hermes-equipo-autonomo-agentes): Multi-agent architectures where AI specialized agents self-coordinate engineering.
- [AI-Driven Development: Beyond the Hype](https://labitcode.com/blog/ai-driven-development) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/desarrollo-guiado-por-ia): Practical engineering guide to AI pair programming in real production pipelines.
- [Designing with Claude: Prompt to Production](https://labitcode.com/blog/anthropic-prompt-engineering-guide) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/disenando-con-claude-del-prompt-a-produccion): Advanced system prompt engineering and structured generation patterns.
- [Fable 5 Export Control Shutdown](https://labitcode.com/blog/fable-5-export-control-shutdown) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/fable-5-controles-exportacion-cierre): Geopolitical AI regulation, US export controls, and sovereign AI implications.

### 2. Software Engineering & Architecture
- [Spec-Driven Development: OpenSpec vs. Spec Kit](https://labitcode.com/blog/spec-driven-development-openspec-vs-spec-kit) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/desarrollo-guiado-por-especificaciones-openspec-vs-spec-kit): Why vibe coding fails at scale and how SDD transforms ambiguity into deterministic software.
- [Playwright with TypeScript: Architecture & Best Practices](https://labitcode.com/blog/playwright-typescript-architecture-best-practices) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/arquitectura-playwright-typescript-mejores-practicas): Enterprise E2E testing framework design, Page Object Model, and scalable CI/CD pipelines.
- [The Death of Sprints: Moving Beyond Agile Theatre](https://labitcode.com/blog/the-death-of-sprints) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/la-muerte-de-los-sprints): Continuous delivery, Shape Up, and asynchronous engineering vs. bi-weekly sprint dogma.
- [Building labitcode: A Modern Engineering Lab](https://labitcode.com/blog/building-labitcode) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/construyendo-labitcode): Astro 5, Tailwind CSS v4, zero-JS by default, and high-performance SSG architecture.

### 3. DevSecOps, Cloud & Infrastructure
- [GitHub Actions Secrets Audit & CI/CD Security](https://labitcode.com/blog/github-actions-secrets-audit-devsecops) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/auditoria-secretos-github-actions-devsecops): Deep technical breakdown of toJSON(secrets) risks, OIDC token poisoning, and defense-in-depth pipeline hardening.
- [The Definitive Guide to VPS Hardening](https://labitcode.com/blog/secure-vps-setup-guide) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/guia-configuracion-vps-seguro): Zero-trust production Linux server hardening: SSH Ed25519, UFW firewall, fail2ban, and kernel sysctl tuning.

### 4. Web Performance & Next-Gen Systems
- [Cloudflare Kitesurf: Stateless V8-Isolate Browser](https://labitcode.com/blog/cloudflare-kitesurf-agentic-browser) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/cloudflare-kitesurf-navegador-agentico): Why headless Chromium is a bottleneck for AI agents, and how Rust/Wasm in V8 isolates cuts CPU/RAM by 7x.
- [PageSpeed Optimization Guide: 100/100 Core Web Vitals](https://labitcode.com/blog/pagespeed-optimization-guide) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/blog/guia-optimizacion-pagespeed): Comprehensive guide to mastering LCP, INP, and CLS on static architectures.

---

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [Labitcode Platform](https://labitcode.com/projects/labitcode-platform) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/projects/plataforma-labitcode): Astro 5 SSG portfolio and technical publication platform built with zero JS runtime overhead.
- [Terreno Rústico Observability Platform](https://labitcode.com/projects/terreno-rustico-monitoring) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/projects/monitorizacion-terreno-rustico): Production-grade telemetry stack with Prometheus, Loki, Promtail, Node Exporter, cAdvisor, and Grafana behind Traefik TLS.
- [Terreno Rústico](https://labitcode.com/projects/terreno-rustico) | [ES](https://labitcode.com/es/projects/terreno-rustico-es): SaaS and GIS platform for agricultural land management and real estate analytics.
